knowledge.heading: CARE — บทวิเคราะห์รายบริษัท: Healthcare260903_SSO_CARE__manual
knowledge.content:
52-week high: 4,865 We hosted Napoom Suwannapoom, Head of Actuarial Division and Actuary at
52-week low: 3,891 the Social Security Office (SSO), for a TISCO Exclusive Talk on Thailand’s ongoing
Avg. Daily Turnover: Social Security Fund pension reform. We discussed the rationale behind the
(THB m) 6,735.03 transition to the new CARE (Career Average Revalued Earnings) formula, its
(USD m) 204.12 impact on the fund’s long-term sustainability, and the implications for Thai
hospitals with significant SSO exposure.
Sector index / rel. to SET
CARE reform to improve benefit fairness, but long-term SSO funding remains
a risk. The new pension calculation (Career Average Revalued Earnings; CARE)
is aimed at making benefits more equitable by better reflecting individual
contributions to SSO, rather than reducing fund expenses. While the new
formula should be broadly neutral to the fund on an aggregate basis, SSO will
need to compensate members who meet two conditions: 1) retire within the
first five years after CARE is implemented; and 2) receive lower pension
benefits under the new formula. Compensation will be paid over their lifetime.
Source: Bloomberg Finance LP
Performance (%) 1m 3m 12m SSO estimates the total transitional cost at around Bt100bn, equivalent to ~4%
